repository_summary: The README for Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Rust describes a pure-Rust library for reading and writing Excel .xlsx files. It is in early-stage development, with broad but incomplete coverage of Aspose.Cells features, and uses samples as the de-facto verification suite. The library is MIT-licensed and maintained as FOSS with a commercial upgrade path. Accurate installation and usage instructions are critical, but current installation prose is inconsistent with the verified manifest coordinates and version.
